rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person who is widely respected by others.

example.english: They have always been respected by the neighbors.
example.traditional: 佢喺街坊之間一向受人尊敬。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 gaai1 fong1 zi1 gaan1 jat1 hoeng3 sau6 jan4 zyun1 ging3

rows.note: Use this when stressing that someone or something deserves respect, rather than simply saying that people respect them.

example.english: They are truly respected for quietly caring for their family for so many years.
example.traditional: 佢多年嚟默默照顧屋企人，真係值得尊敬。
example.jyutping: keoi5 do1 nin4 lai4 mak6 mak6 ziu3 gu3 uk1 kei2 jan4 zan1 hai6 zik6 dak1 zyun1 ging3

rows.note: Use this for an eminent person whose moral character and standing have earned great respect.

example.english: That old principal is highly respected, and even young people admire them.
example.traditional: 嗰位老校長德高望重，連後生仔都好敬重佢。
example.jyutping: go2 wai6 lou5 haau6 zoeng2 dak1 gou1 mong6 zung6 lin4 hau6 saang1 zai2 dou1 hou2 ging3 zung6 keoi5
